meta.title: UAE Location Master List (Authoritative Research Source)
meta.formatRationale: JSON chosen as the single canonical master because hierarchy, enums (type/confidence), bilingual fields, and source citations are structured for later controlled import. Human readability is secondary; do not invent a second MD canonical.

arabicVerification.note: Every record has nameEn, nameAr, arabicSource, arabicConfidence. Where no reliable official Arabic exists, nameAr is the string REVIEW_REQUIRED (never LLM-invented).

meta.uaqCommunityShortfallNote: UAQ community-level official bilingual open data was not obtained this pass; only UAQ City + Falaj Al Mualla included. Slots redistributed to Sharjah Municipality bilingual areas rather than inventing UAQ communities.
meta.publishGate: A location MUST NOT become PUBLISHED/INDEXABLE until Arabic is verified (arabicConfidence=HIGH from an official government/municipality source). REVIEW_REQUIRED and MEDIUM Arabic block publish/index.
meta.scopeNote: This file is a research master only. It does NOT assert serves/licensed/booking coverage. Do not wire into app/seed without a separate approved A2 implementation.
